I have created the single-file brick-breaker game in [index.html](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t2_r1/work/index.html).

### Included Features
- **5 Distinct Levels**: Each level has a unique brick layout; clearing all bricks advances to the next level, and clearing level 5 displays `"You win"`.
- **Lives & Game Over**: Starts with 3 lives; losing the ball deducts a life and shows `"Game over"` at 0 lives.
- **Scoring & Status Bar**: Breaking bricks adds points and updates `"Score: N"`, `"Lives: N"`, `"Level: N"`, and `"Best: N"`.
- **Pause (`P`) & Skip Level (`N`)**: Pressing `P` toggles pause (showing `"Paused"` and freezing all movement); pressing `N` skips to the next level.
- **Persistent Progress**: Current level and best score are saved in `localStorage` and restored across page reloads.
- **Controls**: Playable with Left/Right arrow keys or mouse movement, and `Space` or mouse click to launch the ball.
